units.ms: Per item: ms_unit 'fraction' (share of base MS) or 'flat'.
units.levels: Champion stats per level 1-15 before items and runes.
units.icon: Repository-relative path under assets/riot/; null when there is no icon.

runes.name: First Strike
runes.tooltip: Initiating champion combat (or damaging within 0.25s of engaging) grants 10 gold and First Strike for 3s: deal 7% bonus true damage. Bonus gold: ranged 45%, melee 60% of bonus damage. Cooldown 20–13s (level scaling).

runes.name: Ice Overlord
runes.tooltip: Immobilizing a champion creates ice for 3s. Slow: (1% bonus HP + 15)%. Gain 35 + 75% bonus Armor/MR for 2.5s. Explosion deals 15–100 (level scaling) + 5% bonus HP magic damage. Cooldown 20s.

runes.name: Phase Rush
runes.tooltip: Hit a champion 3 times with attacks/abilities within 4s: gain movement speed and +10 Basic Ability Haste for 3s and reduce remaining basic ability cooldowns by 20%. Cooldown 21–7s.

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.tooltip: Ability damage launches a comet. Damage: 15–100 (level scaling) + 2 × total champion hits + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Cooldown 16–8s.

runes.name: Aery
runes.tooltip: Attacks/abilities send Aery. Damage: 15–70 (level scaling) + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Shield: 25–120 (level scaling) + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP. Cannot resend until Aery returns.

runes.name: Guardian
runes.tooltip: Guard nearby allies for 2.5s. On sufficient champion damage, shield both for 1.5s. Shield: 40–165 + 6% bonus HP + 15% AP. Cooldown 55–25s.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.tooltip: Every 3s in combat, next champion attack: 3.3% max HP bonus magic damage, heal 1.3% max HP, permanently +10 HP. Ranged effects reduced by 60%.

runes.name: Conqueror
runes.tooltip: Separate attacks/abilities grant Adaptive Force for 6s, max 6 stacks. Each stack: 3–5 bonus AD or 5–8 AP (level scaling). At full stacks: ranged 5% / melee 9% bonus Omnivamp.

runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.tooltip: At 100 Energy, next attack gains 40% AS, heals 15–110 + 15% bonus AD + 10% AP, and grants 20% MS for 1s. Champion hit restores 8% missing Mana/Energy.

runes.name: Lethal Tempo
runes.tooltip: Champion attacks grant AS for 6s, max 6 stacks. Ranged: +4.8% AS/stack. At max, attacks fire 6–20 adaptive damage (level scaling), increased 0.33% per 1% bonus AS.

runes.name: Empowerment
runes.tooltip: 3 consecutive champion hits deal 40–165 adaptive damage (level scaling) and amplify damage dealt by 8% until leaving combat. Cooldown 4s.

runes.name: Dark Harvest
runes.tooltip: Damaging a champion below 50% HP deals 35 + 11 per soul + 10% bonus AD + 5% AP adaptive damage and harvests a soul. Cooldown 20s; 1s after takedown.

runes.name: Brutal
runes.tooltip: Attacks deal 6 + 8% bonus AD bonus adaptive damage to champions.

runes.name: Triumph
runes.tooltip: Champion takedowns restore 10% missing Health and 10% max Mana/Energy and grant 35 Movement Speed for 2s.

runes.name: Battle Zeal
runes.tooltip: While in champion combat, gain 1.4% stacking basic ability damage amplification each second, up to 3 stacks.

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.tooltip: Below 60% own HP, attacks vs champions deal 5–11% bonus damage; maximum below 30% HP.

runes.name: Cut Down
runes.tooltip: Attacks deal 6.5% bonus damage to champions above 60% Health.

runes.name: Coup de Grace
runes.tooltip: Deal 8% bonus damage to champions below 40% Health.

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.tooltip: Gain 3% Attack Speed. Takedowns grant up to an additional 18% Attack Speed (21% total max). Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.tooltip: Takedowns grant Ability Haste, capped at 15. Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.tooltip: Gain 1% Omnivamp. Takedowns grant up to an additional 7% (8% total max). Exact stack progression not supplied.

runes.name: Eyeball Collection
runes.tooltip: Champion or epic monster takedown grants 1.5 AD, max 8 stacks (+12 AD).

runes.name: Hubris
runes.tooltip: Champion takedown grants 5 + champion kill count Adaptive Force for 30s.

runes.name: Tyrant
runes.tooltip: Against a champion below 50% HP, deal 20–70 (level scaling) + 6% bonus AD + 3% AP adaptive damage. Cooldown 10s.

runes.name: Chain Assault
runes.tooltip: Ability damage marks a target. Next 2 attacks/active abilities deal 12–38 (level scaling) + 3% bonus AD + 1.5% AP adaptive damage. Cooldown 15s.

runes.name: Sudden Impact
runes.tooltip: After dash/leap/blink/teleport/stealth, next attack/ability within 4s deals 10–65 true damage (level scaling). Cooldown 15s.

runes.name: Cheap Shot
runes.tooltip: Damage to a movement-impaired champion deals 10–45 true damage (level scaling). Cooldown 7s.

runes.name: Zombie Ward
runes.tooltip: Enemy ward takedowns spawn a Zombie Ward for 120s and grant 3 AD or 6 AP, max 5 stacks. Default: max stacks.

runes.name: Empowered Attack
runes.tooltip: Every 8s next champion attack deals 20–60 bonus adaptive damage (level scaling). Ranged champions deal 80% of this damage.

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.tooltip: Gain 10 out-of-combat Movement Speed. Champion/epic monster takedowns grant +2 OOC MS, max 5 stacks. Default: max stacks.

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.tooltip: Every 3 nearby enemy minions or 3 monsters killed permanently grants +3 max HP. At 30 stacks gain +3% Health. Default progression input: 60 stacks.

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.tooltip: After champion damage, current and next 3 champion attacks/abilities within 1.5s deal 30–60 (level scaling) less damage. Cooldown 40s.

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.tooltip: Gain 5 Health every 5s. After champion damage regenerate 3 + 1.5% missing Health over 5s. Doubled for melee.

runes.name: Perseverance
runes.tooltip: Gain 10% Tenacity. When immobilized gain 10–15 Armor and MR (level scaling) for 1.5s.

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.tooltip: Gain 5% amplification when healing or shielding. If target Health is below 40%, gain an additional 10% amplification.

runes.name: Nullifying Orb
runes.tooltip: Champion damage that drops you below 35% max HP grants a 60–180 (level scaling) shield for 4s. Cooldown 60s.

runes.name: Unshakeable
runes.tooltip: Gain 3% Armor/MR plus 2% per nearby enemy champion, max 3. At max nearby enemies also gain 20% Slow Resist. Default: 3 nearby enemies.

runes.name: Courage of the Colossus
runes.tooltip: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants a shield absorbing 25–45 (level scaling) + 1% max Health for 3s. Cooldown 18s.

runes.name: Font of Life
runes.tooltip: Attacks/abilities hitting a champion heal you and the lowest-health nearby ally. Ally: 1.5% max HP + 5% AP. You: 1% max HP + 5% AP. Cooldown 20s. Healing is 130% effective for melee. Does not trigger at full health/no ally.

runes.name: Demolish
runes.tooltip: Third attack against a turret deals bonus physical damage. Ranged: 50 + 20% max Health; melee: 85 + 28% max Health. Cooldown 30s.

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.tooltip: At 6 minutes gain +2 AD; then every 3 minutes increases following the verified sequence 2 → 5 → 9 → 14 → 20 → 27… Exact continuation formula not supplied.

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.tooltip: While above 65% own Health, gain 2–20 AD (level scaling).

runes.name: Scorch
runes.tooltip: Ability hit deals 21–49 magic damage after 1s. Cooldown 8s.

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.tooltip: Ultimate damage/heal/shield +10%; AoE ultimate damage increase +5%. Champion takedown reduces remaining ultimate cooldown by 7%.

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.tooltip: Ability or empowered-attack champion hits permanently grant +30 max Mana, up to +300. Default: full +300.

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.tooltip: Level 1: +5 Ability Haste. Level 5: +5 more. Level 9: basic ability hit reduces ability cooldown time by 8%; this effect has 8s cooldown.

runes.name: Celerity
runes.tooltip: Gain 2% Movement Speed. All Movement Speed bonuses on you are increased by 7%.

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.tooltip: After using a summoner spell gain 10–40% Movement Speed (level scaling) for 3s.

runes.name: Ixtali Seedjar
runes.tooltip: After destroying a plant, gain a seed replacing your trinket for 60s. Seeds become obtainable 2 minutes after game start. Each plant has a unique 30s cooldown.

runes.name: Hexflash
runes.tooltip: While Flash is on cooldown, channel up to 2s to blink; distance depends on channel time. Cooldown 18s; becomes 6s when entering champion combat.

runes.name: Botanist
runes.tooltip: Destroying a plant grants 10 gold and empowers it. Honeyfruit healing +20%; Scryer's Bloom vision duration +20%; Blast Cone grants 40% Movement Speed for 2.5s after knockback.
